startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Public pages to read. The Actor skips any URL that the site's robots.txt disallows.

onlyNew.title: Only new results
onlyNew.description: Return, and charge for, only results that earlier runs with the same search have not returned yet. Turn it on and schedule the Actor (for example daily) to get a feed of new results; a run with nothing new charges no results. The first run returns everything.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Optional, for "Only new results". Runs with the same name share one memory of returned results, even when their other input changes. Without a name, the memory follows the search itself.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many results. Each result is charged once.

maxRequestsPerSecond.title: Maximum requests per second
maxRequestsPerSecond.description: Polite rate limit per website. Keep it low; the Actor also honours Retry-After and backs off on errors.
